eval: (()=>{ const st=document.querySelector('#gc-strips .chip.is-now').title; if(st!=='PAID') throw new Error('구성품 칩 기대 PAID: '+st); return st; })()

(()=>{ const now=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#gc-strips .chip.is-now,#gc-strips .chip.is-branch-now')).map(c=>c.title); if(!now.includes('CANCELED')) throw new Error('구성품 칩 기대 CANCELED: '+now.join('|')); return now.join('|'); })()
(()=>{ const t=document.querySelector('#gc-turn .turn-done, #gc-turn .turn-what').textContent; if(!t.includes('환불 0원')) throw new Error('상품만 싼 제안 + 구성품 먼저 취소면 동의 환불 0원: '+t); return t; })()
